summary: BGM Group Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed pharmaceutical issuer, filed a 6-K announcing a 30-for-1 share consolidation across Class A, Class B and preferred shares, effective at the open on October 1, 2026, with trading continuing under symbol BGM and new CUSIP G7307E131. The consolidation was approved by shareholders at a September 5, 2026 extraordinary general meeting and by the board on August 11, 2026. Outstanding Class A shares of 380,623,358 as of September 21, 2026 will reduce to 12,687,445, subject to fractional-share rounding. Transhare Corporation serves as transfer and exchange agent. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch for reverse-split-related selling pressure and any subsequent Nasdaq compliance or financing motive.
